summary: The diff implements most requirements for hardcoded admin login with 24-hour session persistence. REQ-1 through REQ-4 are fully implemented in AdminGuard.tsx with exact credentials, localStorage-based session management, and automatic redirect. REQ-5 (routing configuration) is addressed in App.tsx with the /admin/dashboard route. However, backend changes in main.mo do not show removal of database checks or OTP verification for the admin login flow, which is explicitly required by REQ-1.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove all external database checks, OTP verification, and any other validation logic for this specific admin ID in the backend admin login function
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows backend/main.mo was modified but truncated. No evidence shows removal of database lookups, OTP checks, or validation logic for the hardcoded admin credentials. The backend must bypass all validation when these specific credentials are used.

hallucinated_features.reason: backend/migration.mo introduces a data migration system with OldActor type containing adminId and adminPassword fields. This was not requested in the BuildRequest and violates the constraint to maintain single-actor backend architecture without introducing additional mechanisms.

hallucinated_features.description: Session validity checking with periodic intervals
hallucinated_features.reason: AdminGuard.tsx implements a 60-second interval check (setInterval(checkSession, 60000)) for session validity. While session persistence is required, periodic polling was not specified and adds unnecessary complexity.
